tei:div.tei:p: This egalitarian adaptation of the Me she’Ana seliḥah for the season of Teshuvah was made by Julia Andelman and Lisa Exler in September 2004. This adaptation was originally published as a PDF in pre-Unicode Hebrew. Re-transcribed for posterity in Unicode Hebrew by Aharon Varady in 2016.
